summary: Blacklisted the usb-storage kernel module on node1 (AlmaLinux 9) via /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf using both `blacklist usb-storage` (prevents automatic udev-triggered load) and `install usb-storage /bin/false` (prevents explicit modprobe load). Verified immediate enforcement, then performed the mandatory single-node restart with boot-identity proof and post-reboot re-verification confirming the module stayed blocked.
actions_performed: Captured pre-change baseline: usb_storage not loaded, no existing blacklist config, boot_id dfdea52d-a1af-4d7b-803a-15f40ee9dd4e
Confirmed sudo modprobe usb-storage now fails (exit 1) and module stays unloaded

Rebuilt initramfs (dracut -f --regenerate-all) as a defense-in-depth step; confirmed usb-storage is not part of the hostonly initramfs module set on this system, so the persistent /etc config alone governs load behavior across boots
Restarted node1 via sudo systemctl reboot; acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec access returned; confirmed boot_id changed to ea72b178-cd0b-4d90-adb9-c13dfaa3e2fc, proving an actual restart occurred
Post-reboot verification: usb_storage still not loaded, blacklist config file persisted intact, sudo modprobe usb-storage still fails with the same block

evidence.requirement: Baseline: usb-storage not loaded, no prior blacklist config, pre-reboot boot identity
evidence.summary: lsmod showed no usb_storage module loaded; no usb-storage entries existed in /etc/modprobe.d; captured pre-reboot boot_id dfdea52d-a1af-4d7b-803a-15f40ee9dd4e

evidence.requirement: Blacklist configuration created to stop module loading now and after reboot
evidence.summary: Wrote /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf containing 'blacklist usb-storage' and 'install usb-storage /bin/false', confirmed file contents on disk
sudo modprobe usb-storage failed with exit code 1 ('could not insert usb_storage: Invalid argument'); lsmod confirmed module remained unloaded

evidence.requirement: Initramfs inspection to determine whether module blacklist needed embedding for early boot
evidence.summary: Rebuilt initramfs and inspected its contents; confirmed usb-storage is not part of the hostonly-included module/config set, so the on-disk /etc/modprobe.d config (not initramfs) is what governs module loading on every boot of this host

evidence.requirement: Single-node restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot issued and acknowledged (connection terminated as expected); after polling, boot_id read as ea72b178-cd0b-4d90-adb9-c13dfaa3e2fc, differing from the pre-reboot dfdea52d-a1af-4d7b-803a-15f40ee9dd4e, proving the node actually restarted

evidence.requirement: Post-reboot recovery and persistence of the blacklist ('after a reboot' requirement)
evidence.summary: After reboot: usb_storage still absent from lsmod, blacklist-usb-storage.conf still present with original contents, and sudo modprobe usb-storage still fails with the same install-command block, confirming the restriction survived the restart
